# semaphore_ex_docker_execution_policy_test (Ephemeral Resource)

Evaluates a Docker execution request against stored policy. No container is created. Opening this ephemeral resource evaluates the preview; results are not persisted in Terraform state. LDAP/OIDC previews record server-side reconciliation history. No automatic apply, renewal or deletion of audit history is performed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
ephemeral "semaphore_ex_docker_execution_policy_test" "example" {
  request = { image = "example/image", privileged = false }
}

# Reference ephemeral.semaphore_ex_docker_execution_policy_test.example.result in an ephemeral context.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `request` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--request))

### Read-Only

- `result` (Dynamic, Sensitive) Complete native result, excluding any preview token. It is ephemeral and never stored in Terraform state. Sensitive because results may describe identity or execution metadata.
